title: A separably generated field extension is separable
statement: Let $K/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] which is separably generated in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension] (1), i.e. there is a transcendence basis $(x_i)_{i\in I}$ of $K/k$ such that $K/k(x_i;i\in I)$ is separable algebraic. Then $K$ is separable over $k$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension] (2): every subextension $k\subset K''\subset K$ with $K''$ finitely generated over $k$ is separably generated over $k$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 030X (lemma-separably-generated-separable, line 10410) and its proof (combine Lemma Tag 030U lemma-separable-extension-preserves-reducedness with Lemma Tag 030W lemma-characterize-separable-field-extensions)

proof.text: (Case distinction on the characteristic.) The characteristic of the field $k$ is either $0$ or a prime number $p$. If it is $0$, then by [lem-weil-pbc-char-zero-field-extension-separable] every field extension of $k$, in particular $K$, is separable over $k$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension] (2), and the lemma holds (the hypothesis that $K/k$ is separably generated is not needed in this case). From now on $k$ has characteristic $p>0$.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 030X (lemma-separably-generated-separable, line 10410), which combines 030U with Lemma Tag 030W, the latter stated only in characteristic p > 0; the characteristic-zero case is the remark 'In characteristic zero any field extension is separable' in the proof of Lemma Tag 00TX (lemma-characteristic-zero-local-smooth, line 38835)

proof.text: (K is geometrically reduced.) Let $L/k$ be any field extension. A field has no nonzero nilpotent elements, so $L$ is a reduced (commutative) $k$-algebra. Since $K/k$ is separably generated in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension] (1), [lem-weil-pbc-separably-generated-tensor-reduced] applied with $S=L$ shows that $K\otimes_kL$ is reduced. Thus $K\otimes_kL$ is reduced for every field extension $L/k$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 030U (lemma-separable-extension-preserves-reducedness, line 10152), separably generated case, as used in the proof of Lemma Tag 030X; this is condition (4) of Lemma Tag 030W (Definition Tag 030S, definition-geometrically-reduced)

proof.text: (Conclusion.) Now $k$ has characteristic $p>0$ and, by step 2, $K\otimes_kL$ is reduced for every field extension $L/k$. By [lem-weil-pbc-geometrically-reduced-extension-separable] (Stacks 030W, (4) $\Rightarrow$ (1)), $K$ is separable over $k$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension] (2): every subextension $k\subset K''\subset K$ finitely generated over $k$ is separably generated over $k$. Together with step 1 this proves the lemma in every characteristic.
